name: Agentic Task
description: An external task that an autonomous agent performs, bounded by a max autonomy window and (optionally) required to leave evidence before it can complete. Max Autonomy Seconds, Evidence Required, and the notes field are configured in the "Agentic Task" properties-panel group below, not here — element templates can't bind to the custom fluxnova:agentic namespace those live in.
